$comment: Error page copy. STAR-168 rules still hold (operator rulings 2026-10-24): never imply a page exists, no promises or timelines, 429 = a limit for now, 401 = sign-in not open (invitation only) until launch, contact = hello@starhold.dev (build.mjs links it). STAR-299 (operator, 2026-11-20): plain headlines and short sentences that say what happened and what to do next; the space titles live on in the art only. Every page also carries the four 'next' links below. build.mjs renders it into every page.

launched.$comment: STAR-142 launch switch: when LAUNCHED is true (apps/storefront/src/lib/launch.ts) these entries replace the same code under codes. Nothing here renders while the switch is off.

401.title: Please sign in to see this page
401.explanation: This page is for signed-in accounts. Please sign in with your Starhold Account at https://starship.starhold.app, then try again. Or start from the home page.

400.title: I could not read that request
400.explanation: A link may have been cut short, or a form arrived incomplete. Go back and try again, or start from the home page.

401.title: This page needs a sign-in
401.explanation: This page is for signed-in accounts, and sign-in is not open yet: access is by invitation only. Go back, or start from the home page.

403.title: This page is not open to you
403.explanation: If you followed a link you expected to work, its access may have changed. Go back, or email hello@starhold.dev with the address.

404.title: I cannot find that page
404.explanation: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may have a typo in it. Go back, or start from the home page.

405.title: That page cannot do what was asked
405.explanation: Your browser sent the wrong kind of request for this address, for example a form sent to a page that only shows information. Go back and use the page's own form or button.

410.title: This page has been removed
410.explanation: It was removed on purpose and is not coming back. The home page shows what is available now. If you relied on it, email hello@starhold.dev.

429.title: Too many requests for now
429.explanation: This service limits how many requests it accepts from one connection, and yours has reached that limit for now. Wait a while, then try again. When the service knows how long the limit lasts, its reply says so.

500.title: Something went wrong on my side
500.explanation: It is not something you did. Try again later. If it keeps happening, check the status page, or email hello@starhold.dev and say roughly when it happened.

502.title: I could not reach the service behind this page
502.explanation: The problem is on my side, not yours. Try again later, or check the status page.

503.title: This service is not answering right now
503.explanation: It is usually restarting or under maintenance. Try again later, or check the status page. If it stays down, email hello@starhold.dev.

504.title: The service took too long to answer
504.explanation: I stopped waiting for it. Try again later, or check the status page. If the same page keeps timing out, email hello@starhold.dev.

default.title: Something went wrong
default.explanation: This page could not be shown. Go back, or start from the home page. If it keeps happening, email hello@starhold.dev and say roughly when it happened.
